final: WITH matches AS (SELECT r.ordervault AS profile_order_reference, o.dealedge AS order_side FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault COLLATE BINARY = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY), groups AS (SELECT profile_order_reference, order_side, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM matches GROUP BY profile_order_reference COLLATE BINARY, order_side COLLATE BINARY), side_totals AS (SELECT order_side, SUM(group_count) AS side_total FROM groups GROUP BY order_side COLLATE BINARY) SELECT g.profile_order_reference, g.order_side, g.group_count, CAST(g.group_count AS REAL) / t.side_total AS quotient FROM groups AS g JOIN side_totals AS t ON g.order_side COLLATE BINARY = t.order_side COLLATE BINARY ORDER BY quotient DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
